history.title: Learn from history
history.description: Heat Planner can read the last 30 days from Home Assistant's own history to learn how fast each room heats up and cools down, and how much power each heater uses. This makes the expected temperature and the cost estimates much more accurate. The data never leaves your Home Assistant.

energy.title: Electricity contract and capacity tariff
energy.description: What you actually pay per kWh decides what is worth doing. With a fixed price (e.g. Norgespris) moving heat between hours saves almost nothing – then the grid tariff and keeping the monthly peak low matter most.

alerts.description: Heat Planner always fires the event `heat_planner_alert` (kind, message, entry_id) for automations. Optionally it can also send a short notification.

price_unavailable.title: {title}: no electricity prices
price_unavailable.description:
Heat Planner has had no price for the current hour from {source} for several hours, so it heats by the schedule only and cannot save money.

Check that the price integration is working (Settings → Devices & services). If you use Tibber, its login may have expired: open the Tibber integration and re-authenticate. This message disappears by itself when prices are back.

house_meter_unavailable.title: {title}: whole-house power meter unavailable
house_meter_unavailable.description:
The whole-house power meter {entity} has been unavailable for more than an hour. Without it Heat Planner cannot keep the monthly power peak low and only counts the heaters' own load.

If the meter is a Tibber Pulse, the Tibber login has probably expired: open the Tibber integration under Settings → Devices & services and re-authenticate. For a HAN/AMS reader, check that it is online. You can also remove the meter under Configure → Electricity contract and capacity tariff.

recorder_missing.title: {title}: history is not available
recorder_missing.description:
Learn from history is turned on, but the Recorder integration is not running, so Heat Planner cannot learn how fast the rooms heat and cool, or when people come home.

Enable the recorder (it is part of default_config), or turn off Learn from history under Configure → Learn from history.
